name: hook4
text: Chatbot or agent: what's the difference?

name: intro
text: I'm Kenil, and this is TechXKenil.

name: chat4
text: A chatbot answers. An agent acts.

name: trip4
text: Ask a chatbot to plan a trip, and you get a plan. An agent searches flights, compares prices, and fills in the form.

name: loop4
text: It runs in a loop with tools: think, act, observe, repeat.

name: same4
text: Same model underneath. The difference is the loop and the tools.

name: guard4
text: That's why agents are powerful, and why they need guardrails. They can do wrong things too.

name: outro
text: Subscribe to TechXKenil for more AI and tech.
